scope: Prevent unqualified AcDbSubDMesh trailing-bit patterns from being accepted or emitted while retaining the shared physical profile.

basis.normativeStatus: ODA v5.4.1 does not publish an AcDbSubDMesh body layout.

implementation.parser: Accept only trailing candidate bits 10. Reject the other three two-bit patterns and reset the typed entity on refusal. This avoids treating a possible nonzero BitLong prefix as two flags.
implementation.writer: Emit the canonical 10 sequence for model default unknown=0 and observed-profile unknown=1. Reject unknown masks 2 and 3 before writing any body, string, or handle bits.
implementation.apiComment: Document the observed-profile bound and default canonical encoding without claiming flag semantics.

focusedTests.coverage: Generated parser vectors admit only 10 and check atomic reset for other candidates. Writer vectors check exact 10 output and refusal of masks 2/3 across AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032.

composedRoundTrip.detail: The generated MESH capability/readback assertions pass after updating their expected canonical mask. The full round-trip test still fails at AC1021 with 'dwg-object-callback — DWG object callback reported a required write failure', followed by 507 aggregate assertions. This packet did not isolate or resolve that independent object callback failure.

supersedes.scope: Its all-mask parser/writer controls establish implementation mechanics only. This receipt narrows parser admission and writer output to the observed shared 10 profile; it does not resolve the underlying schema.

limitations: The body layout and meaning of the trailing data remain unresolved.
The other three two-bit patterns remain unsupported until a normative layout or a discriminating, traceable producer resolves them.
This does not qualify MESH topology, subdivision semantics, crease effects, native geometry, or whole-document conversion.
The composed local DWG round-trip test remains failing at an AC1021 object callback.
